[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested traditional Pomeranian dishes include:  
1. Bigos - A hearty stew made with sauerkraut, meat, and various vegetables.  
2. Zrazy - Thin slices of beef stuffed with vegetables, bacon, and spices, rolled up and slow-cooked.  
3. Kopytka - Small potato dumplings similar to gnocchi, often served with sautéed onions and bacon.
